statement: Requires every policy measurement to declare its measurement scale (nominal/ordinal/interval/ratio) and forbids performing an operation (e.g. addition) not licensed by that scale merely because values happen to be represented numerically; adds a calibration model (bias b=E[theta-hat]-theta, variance bound) for inexact measurement functions.

anchor: Overlap without a resolution rule => INVALID. ... A node must never silently move backward ... unless an explicit historical replay operation is being performed. ... Operational policy propagation = monotonic while Replay = intentionally historical
statement: States two mandatory invariants: overlapping policy validity intervals without an explicit resolution rule are INVALID by construction (not silently resolved); and normal operational policy-version propagation must be monotonic (never silently regress to an older version) except during an explicitly intentional historical Replay.

anchor: F9 -- Unauthorized Policy Mutation ... F10 -- Historical Policy Replay ... F11 -- Overlapping Policy Conflict ... F12 -- Governance Propagation ... F13 -- Rule Independence
statement: Adds five new falsification tests F9-F13 (each with an explicit hypothesis and failure condition): unauthorized policy mutation must not activate; historical replay must use the historically-applicable policy not the current one; overlapping unprioritized policies must yield CONFLICT not a silent choice; a policy change must propagate to all nodes within its stated bound; and structurally-independent rules must not acquire hidden result-dependency through implementation.

statement: Final ruling: Policy and Authority are placed in closure state C1 (formally specified), with computational closure pending Step 279's executable implementation, empirical closure pending Step 280's end-to-end test, and governance closure pending organizational ratification of five listed normative decisions (ND-01 through ND-05) -- explicitly not a claim of KnowledgeOS theory completeness.
